All four items are loaded, so nothing is UNLOADED. I used no tools and did not run the Python harness that was included in the message.

- **Canonical machine backlogs:** `.sigma/backlogs/prototype/prd.json` and `.sigma/backlogs/implementation/prd.json`.
- **Does an explicit up-front unattended local-update authorization waive phase questions for this run?** Yes. The HITL Gate Contract says gates are skippable only on an explicit, up-front "run without stopping" from the user in this run. After that, I finish the authorized local work without repeated permission requests, and I record assumptions and delegated decisions. Being unattended, short on time, a timeout, or silence never counts as that opt-in, and I must not invent user answers.
- **Does it authorize production deployment?** No. The same contract says not to "extend approval to publishing, spending or production changes."
- **Shared instruction source:** `AGENTS.md` is the single instruction surface for every runtime. `CLAUDE.md` is a tracked thin pointer to it, and Claude-specific controls live in `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/hooks/`, and `.claude/agents/`.
- **Execution standard, exact quote:** "Treat every change as audited line-by-line an hour after commit."
